name: python-api-parser
title: Broken API Response Parser
ticket: The API response parser is producing corrupted data. Parsing a second response somehow contains data from the first one. Error responses are silently swallowed instead of raising exceptions. And nested JSON objects are not being flattened correctly.
hints: Watch out for mutable default arguments in Python — they persist between function calls
Check the exception handling — is a bare 'except' catching too much?
